title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 32
description: Ten questions on Numbers 32: Reuben and Gad ask for land east of the Jordan and promise to fight with their brothers.

questions.text: Which two tribes had a very great multitude of livestock and wanted the land of Jazer and Gilead?
questions.explanation: The children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of livestock and saw that the land was a place for livestock.

questions.text: What did Gad and Reuben ask Moses not to do?
questions.explanation: They asked that the land be given to them for a possession and said, "Don't bring us over the Jordan."

questions.text: What did Moses ask Gad and Reuben in response?
questions.explanation: Moses asked them, "Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?"

answers.text: "Why have you sinned against Yahweh at Peor?"
"Have you forgotten the manna in the wilderness?"
"Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?"

questions.text: To which valley did their fathers go up before they discouraged Israel?
questions.explanation: Their fathers, sent from Kadesh Barnea, went up to the valley of Eshcol, saw the land and discouraged the heart of Israel.

questions.text: Who were the only men who came out of Egypt that would see the land, because they followed Yahweh completely?
questions.explanation: None of the men from twenty years old and upward would see the land, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh and Joshua the son of Nun.

questions.text: For how long did Yahweh make Israel wander in the wilderness?
questions.explanation: Yahweh made them wander back and forth in the wilderness forty years, until the evil generation was consumed.

questions.text: What did Gad and Reuben promise they would do themselves?
questions.explanation: They would build sheepfolds and cities, but they themselves would be ready armed to go before the children of Israel until they had brought them to their place.

answers.text: Stay behind to guard the cities
Go armed before the other tribes
Pay a tribute of their livestock
Send their sons in their place

questions.text: Complete Moses' warning: "Be sure your sin will..."
questions.explanation: Moses said that if they did not do so, they had sinned against Yahweh, and "be sure your sin will find you out."

questions.text: Besides Gad and Reuben, who received the kingdoms of Sihon and Og from Moses?
questions.explanation: Moses gave the kingdoms of Sihon and Og to Gad, to Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph.

questions.text: What name did Nobah give to Kenath after he took it?
questions.explanation: Nobah took Kenath and its villages, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
